full_judgment: 4. That when the plaintiff was a student of Salander High School, he with Bhagirath and his 4th wife Padma Muni went to India and took shelter in the camp of Bhaispita in the year 1971; before that, the defendant Nos.1, 2 and 4 went to India and took shelter in the camp of Laxmipur; Bhagirath died of cholera in the Bhaispita Camp; the plaintiff as an adopted son put fired on the mouth of Bhagirath at the Cremation; then, the plaintiff left this place and went to the camp of Barag and after liberation they came back to the country. After the death of Bhagirath, the plaintiff became the owner of the entire property of Bhagirath and with Padmamuni, he lived in their homestead as well as the defendant No.1, 2 and 4 came back and used to live in their old house; at the time of death of Bhagirath the plaintiff was minor boy so through his 4th mother, he possessed and enjoyed the property and cultivating the same by own plough and by Bargadar; when the plaintiff became adult he got married and lived with the defendant No.3 along with his wife and sons and seeing his peaceful life, the defendant No.1, 2 and 4 became Jealous of him and out of enmity the defendant No.1 and 2 filed a Criminal Case being MP No. 235/83 against the plaintiff and his uncle's son Tarini and the defendant No.2 in this case stated that she took the defendant No.1 as adopted son for his own choice; thereafter, the defendant No.1 created a forged and ante-dated kabala for grabbing the property of the plaintiff. The defendant No.1 filed another criminal case under section 144 of the CrPC and filed Case No. 38C/87 and both the cases were dismissed. The defendant No.1 in MP 75/87 and NGR 41/87 stated that the father's name of the plaintiff is Kaichu Barman and the defendant No.2 stated this false statement and the defendant No. 1 himself claimed that he is an adopted son of Bhagirath and in all these Criminal cases they stated that the plaintiff is a servant of Bhagirath then the plaintiff filed this suit for declaration that the plaintiff is the adopted son of Bhagirathh and the defendant No.1 is not the adopted son of Bhagirath.
